messages.text: somethings off with the cart
sorry that was unhelpful. i mean the subtotal updates a beat late when you change quantity, so for a second it shows the old number. noticed it on staging, chrome, desktop
promo codes are getting rejected on staging. tried SPRING20 and WELCOME10, both come back invalid. those are live codes in the current store so i assume they should work?
CHECKOUT IS DOWN

sorry for the caps. prod checkout, customers hit Pay and get a white screen. started around 9:40 our time. we've had it maybe 25 min. can someone get on this right now, i have to tell our CEO something
support has 14 tickets in the last half hour. Priya is holding all replies until you tell me what we're allowed to say
ok it looks like it's back? placed a test order and it went through. what happened, i need something in writing for the 4pm
test order 4471 failed on staging. card declined, but that's the always-approve test card. happy to send the order id if that helps
staging build is erroring for me. blank white page and the console has something about a chunk failing to load. could easily be my machine
nvm, hard refresh fixed it. sorry for the noise
Marcus says the inventory sync ran overnight but the ceramic mug counts didn't move at all. every other category updated fine
is it normal for the confirmation email to take ~6 minutes? not complaining, just want to know if that's the expected behavior before i tell support it's fine
we got an alert from the payments dashboard, three events sitting in failed delivery. no idea if that's meaningful on your side
ok it's not three. i sorted by date and there are failed retries going back to tuesday. 60 something
so if i'm reading this right the money is landing but our system never hears about it. that's the part that's freaking me out. tell me i'm wrong
hey when you get a sec, the guest checkout button vanishes if you resize the browser window. narrow to wide specifically. nobody real is going to do that but it made me nervous about the layout logic

hey avery im driving so this is voice so sorry period marcus just called and he says the admin is showing negative stock on the canvas totes like negative fourteen which obviously cant be right can somebody look before the warehouse pulls their morning count thanks
this is probably nothing but the cart badge sometimes shows 2 when there's 1 item in there
forwarding from Renata in finance: "the daily settlement total is off from what our orders say by about $340, can someone look before month end"
correction, Renata says it's $34 not $340. she typed it wrong. still a gap but a much less exciting one, sorry for the fire drill
no rush at all, but every footer link on the new templates goes to a 404
search returns nothing for "tote". we sell nine totes
did something change on the address form? a customer wrote in saying it wouldn't take her apartment number. i can't reproduce it but she sent a screenshot and the field is definitely red
is it a problem that the staging site is showing up on google? someone on my team found it searching our own product name. maybe that's fine, i don't know how that works
we oversold the linen runner. 12 orders, we had 4. that's a real problem, those are all going to be refunds or angry emails
i'm getting pinged by three separate people about the checkout thing and i don't have anything to tell them. even a "we're looking" helps me right now

calmer version of the above: two orders in the last hour show as paid in the payment dashboard but never created an order record on our side. timestamps 11:02 and 11:19. i can pull the reference numbers if useful
we had a decline spike this morning, turned out to be our own fraud rules, not you. already fixed on our end. ignore
remember the mobile menu thing i flagged yesterday? it was a browser extension on Theo's laptop. false alarm, sorry
genuine question not a bug report: should the discount apply before or after tax? ours is doing it after and i honestly don't know which is correct
checkout feels slow today. not broken, just slow. like 4-5 seconds after you hit continue
people are getting logged out mid checkout. or at least their cart empties. two reports this morning, both said they were on mobile and had been on the site a while before buying
inventory counts drifted again overnight. Marcus is comparing against the warehouse sheet now but he says at least six SKUs are off by small amounts. not zeros, just wrong by 1-3
half the product images on the kitchen category page aren't loading. gray boxes
a customer says she was charged twice for order 5518. i can see two authorizations. this one i need an answer on today because she's already emailed twice and she's not wrong to be annoyed
not sure this is a bug but the quantity stepper lets you go to 0 and then the item just sits there in the cart at 0. seems like it should remove itself or stop at 1
the phase 1 cohort is still landing on the old checkout. at least some of them. Jules tested with her personal email and got the old one twice, then the new one on the third try
tax is coming out wrong for Washington. everything else i spot checked was fine, just that one state, and it's low by a few cents which is somehow worse than being obviously broken
hey are you seeing errors on your side or is this just us

forwarded from our IT guy: "the nightly job is failing with a timeout on the product feed, third night in a row, i don't own that so i'm sending it your way." i don't know what that means but passing it along
sorry to be that person again but the cart total is wrong when you have more than 3 items

this is the third time this week that staging has been down when i sat down to review something. i'm not trying to be difficult, but i keep blocking out time to look at things and then not being able to look at them
on a call, quick thing, the shipping options dropdown is empty for zip 04421. will send more later
gift cards aren't applying at all. the field takes the code, the page reloads, nothing happens to the total. we sold a lot of these in december so this one matters more than it sounds
hitting back from the payment step wipes the whole cart. i did it by accident and lost everything, and then i did it again on purpose to make sure it wasn't a fluke. it wasn't
the Apple Play button isn't showing up on iphone anymore. it was there last week i'm pretty sure
design revisions look great but the header is still using the old font. everything below it updated

our accessibility consultant flagged that the error messages on the payment form aren't announced by screen readers. she said it's a real fail not a nitpick. i'll forward her full note when she sends it
somethings weird with the order confirmation page. cant put my finger on it. it just doesnt look like what we approved

refunds issued in the admin aren't showing as refunded on the customer's order page. they still say paid. Priya has been telling people to just trust her that the money is coming which is not a great look
everything worked when i tested last night and now nothing does. did something deploy?
seeing duplicate orders in the admin. same customer, same items, timestamps 2 seconds apart. i think people are double clicking pay but the button should stop them from doing that right
stock is showing negative again. -3 on two SKUs. i know i flagged this last week and you said the sync fix went out
can we push the check-in? we have something going on with checkout and i'd rather all our people be on that
false alarm on the incident, it was our CDN provider having a moment, unrelated to anything you built. check-in is back on for the normal time
sold out badge is showing on items that are in stock. only on the collection pages, product pages look right

so this is going to be a long one sorry. a customer emailed us a screenshot where the order summary shows one price and the button underneath shows a different price, like $88 vs $94, and i went to reproduce it and couldn't, and then Priya reproduced it once and couldn't do it again, and now i'm sitting here not sure if we have a real problem or two people who misread something. is there any way to see what she actually saw? happy to send you the email
quick sanity check: should the cart survive if someone closes the tab and comes back an hour later? ours doesn't and i can't remember what we agreed
receipt email shows the pre-discount total. the charge is correct, the email is wrong. customers are going to think we overcharged them
logo is pixelated in the header on retina screens. tiny thing, but it's the first thing on the page
the staging password prompt keeps coming back even after i check remember me. every single time. is that on purpose

we had a report of the site being totally down at like 6am but by the time anyone checked it was fine. nothing in our monitoring. flagging in case you have logs that show something, otherwise happy to let it go

hey so this might be nothing but the inventory number on the product page and the number in the admin disagree by 1 on a few items. could just be timing between syncs? if that's expected i'll stop looking at it
i think we broke something. i was in the admin changing a shipping rate and now the checkout is showing free shipping on everything. i probably did this. sorry. can someone look

ok i need to be straight with you. we are eight days from the full launch and in the last four days i've reported checkout going down once, the webhook thing, the inventory drift twice, and a handful of smaller stuff. individually every one of these has an explanation. together it doesn't feel like a system that's ready and i'm the one who has to stand up in front of our leadership on monday and say we're going. i'm not asking you to fix it all today, i'm asking whether you actually think we're ready, and i need you to tell me honestly if you don't
the double charge from earlier resolved itself, the second auth dropped off overnight. customer's been told. closing that one out
one more before i log off, the mobile keyboard covers the card number field on smaller iphones so you can't see what you're typing. not blocking but it feels bad
